279618441.description: This vintage Sheaffer desk set includes a gold-tone fountain pen and a solid brass pen holder with a decorative agate or onyx insert. The pen features a distinctive Sheaffer inlaid nib and a black grip section. The brass base is inscribed with 'Gibsons of the Greenbrier' and includes a seal, suggesting it was a custom or commemorative piece for the Greenbrier resort. The set shows signs of age including tarnish and spotting on the brass components but remains in overall good vintage condition. The substantial pen stand likely dates from the mid-20th century.

279469811.description:
Mixed Semi-Precious Stone and Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 5.9 lbs
This extensive collection contains nearly six pounds of diverse semi-precious stones and crystals, offering a variety of colors, textures, and mineral types. The lot includes a mix of large raw, unpolished specimens and smaller tumbled, polished stones, making it suitable for lapidary work, metaphysical practices, or decorative display. Notable large pieces include rough rose quartz and fluorite, alongside a wide array of jaspers, agates, and quartz varieties.
Diverse mineral mix including Rose Quartz, Amethyst, Fluorite, and Jasper
Combination of raw, rough-cut specimens and smooth tumbled stones
Varieties of Jasper: Red, Yellow, and Dalmatian patterns observed
Total lot weight of approximately 5.95 pounds as provided
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. As natural mineral specimens, pieces exhibit characteristic inclusions, natural fractures, and varied textures inherent to their geological formation. Tumbled stones show a smooth, polished finish, while rough specimens retain their natural crystalline structures. The stones are provided in a mixed bulk lot.
